IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf ProposedEnergyProducerOption IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf ProposedEnergyProducerOption IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

root anyOf ProposedBatteryUnitOption ProposedBatteryUnitOption.InverterController anyOf ConstantPFControlMode IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf ProposedBatteryUnitOption ProposedBatteryUnitOption.InverterController anyOf ConstantPFControlMode IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf ProposedBatteryUnitOption IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf ProposedBatteryUnitOption IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf ProposedBatteryUnitOption IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.description

root anyOf ProposedPhotoVoltaicUnitOption IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf ProposedPhotoVoltaicUnitOption IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf ProposedPhotoVoltaicUnitOption IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf ProposedPhotoVoltaicUnitOption IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.description

root anyOf ProposedWindUnitOption IdentifiedObject.description
Type: string

The description is a free human readable text describing or naming the object. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf ProposedWindUnitOption IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf ProposedWindUnitOption IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf ProposedWindUnitOption IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.

IdentifiedObject.aliasName

root anyOf ProposedGeneratingUnitOption IdentifiedObject.aliasName
Type: string

The aliasName is free text human readable name of the object alternative to IdentifiedObject.name. It may be non unique and may not correlate to a naming hierarchy.
The attribute aliasName is retained because of backwards compatibility between CIM relases. It is however recommended to replace aliasName with the Name class as aliasName is planned for retirement at a future time.

IdentifiedObject.mRID

root anyOf ProposedGeneratingUnitOption IdentifiedObject.mRID
Type: string

Master resource identifier issued by a model authority. The mRID is unique within an exchange context. Global uniqueness is easily achieved by using a UUID, as specified in RFC 4122, for the mRID. The use of UUID is strongly recommended.
For CIMXML data files in RDF syntax conforming to IEC 61970-552, the mRID is mapped to rdf:ID or rdf:about attributes that identify CIM object elements.

IdentifiedObject.name

root anyOf ProposedGeneratingUnitOption IdentifiedObject.name
Type: string

The name is any free human readable and possibly non unique text naming the object.
